title: Complete arithmetic for Complexe
hints: Write `+=`, `-=`, `*=` as members returning `*this` by reference.
Then `+`, `-`, `*` as free functions built from them: `Complexe res{ a }; return res += b;` (slide 142).
`==` can be defaulted in C++20: `bool operator==(const Complexe&) const = default;`.
